questName->Military tribunal summons
questName->Fleet judicial notice

questDescription(defendantRanked==True)->A sergeant of the military police command of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has issued a notice over the public band, expressing [asker_possessive] strictly-official concern over the recent military-diplomatic incident caused by [playerFactionName]. As [playerFactionName] counts enlisted personnel of [issuerFactionName] among its members, [asker_pronoun] intends to settle the matter through formal court-martial proceedings.

By [asker_possessive] account, the highest-ranking officer of [playerFactionName], [defendant_nameFull], must report to the fleet's local military tribunal for investigation and questioning. Should [playerFactionName] cooperate, [asker_pronoun] will immediately requisition an orbital transport to collect [defendant_nameDef], and hostilities between [issuerFactionName] and [playerFactionName] will be suspended for the duration.

[asker_nameDef] tells us the investigation will conclude within [investigationDays] days, after which the accused will answer for the charges in court, the verdict to be pronounced by the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall and executed at once. If [defendant_nameDef] cooperates, [defendant_possessive] punishment will be weighed leniently, though given the gravity of a military incident, it will still mean short-term detention and a demotion at the very least.

Room, board and medical care during [defendant_possessive] sentence will be borne by [issuerFactionName], and [defendant_pronoun] will be returned to [playerFactionName] once it is served.

questDescription(defendantRanked==True)->Over the public band, [asker_nameFull], a duty sergeant of the [issuerFactionName] military police command, has served us formal notice: the recent military-diplomatic incident attributed to [playerFactionName] will not be ignored. Because members of [playerFactionName] remain on the [issuerFactionName] service roll, [asker_pronoun] insists the affair be resolved before a proper court-martial rather than on a battlefield.

The terms are plain. Our highest-ranking officer, [defendant_nameFull], is to submit to investigation and questioning at the fleet's local tribunal. Upon our agreement, [asker_pronoun] will requisition an orbital transport for [defendant_nameDef] without delay, and [issuerFactionName] will hold its guns for as long as the proceedings run.

Per [asker_nameDef], the inquiry closes within [investigationDays] days; the accused will then speak in [defendant_possessive] own defense before the bench, and the Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] will pass sentence for immediate execution. Cooperation buys leniency, but a military incident of this weight carries no less than brief detention and one grade of demotion.

The fleet will feed, house and treat [defendant_nameDef] throughout the sentence, and return [defendant_pronoun] to [playerFactionName] when it ends.

questDescription(defendantRanked==True)->[asker_nameFull], sergeant of the military police command, [issuerFactionName], has broadcast an official communiqué regarding the military-diplomatic incident recently caused by [playerFactionName]. [asker_pronoun] frames it as nothing personal, merely procedure: since [playerFactionName] harbors personnel still enrolled with [issuerFactionName], the matter falls under military jurisdiction and must go before a court-martial.

[asker_pronoun] requires that [defendant_nameFull], the senior rank-holder of [playerFactionName], attend the fleet's local tribunal for investigation and questioning. The moment we consent, an orbital transport will be requisitioned to carry [defendant_nameDef] up, and [issuerFactionName] will suspend all hostilities against [playerFactionName] pending judgment.

As [asker_nameDef] lays it out: [investigationDays] days of investigation, then the accused argues [defendant_possessive] defense in open court, and the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall pronounces sentence on the spot. Willing cooperation will be weighed in mitigation, but the minimum remains short-term detention plus demotion by one grade.

Quarters, rations and medical care during the sentence come at [issuerFactionName]'s expense; [defendant_pronoun] will be shipped back to [playerFactionName] on release.

questDescription(defendantRanked==False)->A sergeant of the military police command of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has issued a notice over the public band, expressing [asker_possessive] strictly-official concern over the recent military-diplomatic incident caused by [playerFactionName]. No member of [playerFactionName] holds a commission [asker_pronoun] could act against, so [asker_pronoun] intends to proceed against the settlement itself, through formal court-martial proceedings.

By [asker_possessive] account, [playerFactionName] must surrender the member it can least afford to lose, [defendant_nameFull], to the fleet's local military tribunal for investigation and questioning. Should [playerFactionName] cooperate, [asker_pronoun] will immediately requisition an orbital transport to collect [defendant_nameDef], and hostilities between [issuerFactionName] and [playerFactionName] will be suspended for the duration.

[asker_nameDef] tells us the investigation will conclude within [investigationDays] days, after which the accused will answer for the charges in court, the verdict to be pronounced by the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall and executed at once. There is no rank here to reduce, so nothing can be taken off in mitigation: the sentence is detention, and the whole of it.

Room, board and medical care during [defendant_possessive] sentence will be borne by [issuerFactionName], and [defendant_pronoun] will be returned to [playerFactionName] once it is served.

questDescription(defendantRanked==False)->Over the public band, [asker_nameFull], a duty sergeant of the [issuerFactionName] military police command, has served us formal notice: the recent military-diplomatic incident attributed to [playerFactionName] will not be ignored. The terms are plain. [playerFactionName] is to hand over whoever it values most, and by the fleet's reckoning that is [defendant_nameFull]. Upon our agreement, [asker_pronoun] will requisition an orbital transport for [defendant_nameDef] without delay, and [issuerFactionName] will hold its guns for as long as the proceedings run.

The fleet will feed, house and treat [defendant_nameDef] throughout the sentence, and return [defendant_pronoun] to [playerFactionName] when it ends.

questDescription(defendantRanked==Deviant)->A sergeant of the military police command of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has issued a notice over the public band. The fleet's rolls show that [playerFactionName] is sheltering [defendant_nameFull], a deviant who walked out on [issuerFactionName] with sealed files in hand, and [asker_pronoun] intends to settle the matter before a court-martial rather than with another hunting party.

By [asker_possessive] account, [defendant_nameDef] must report to the fleet's local military tribunal to answer for desertion and the leak. Should [playerFactionName] cooperate, [asker_pronoun] will immediately requisition an orbital transport to collect [defendant_nameDef], and hostilities between [issuerFactionName] and [playerFactionName] will be suspended for the duration.

[asker_nameDef] tells us the investigation will conclude within [investigationDays] days, after which the accused will answer for the charges in court, the verdict to be pronounced by the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall and executed at once. Once the case is closed, the fleet will call off its hunt for [defendant_objective].

Room, board and medical care during [defendant_possessive] sentence will be borne by [issuerFactionName], and [defendant_pronoun] will be returned to [playerFactionName] once it is served.[killOrderNote]

questDescription(defendantRanked==Deviant)->Over the public band, [asker_nameFull], a duty sergeant of the [issuerFactionName] military police command, has served us formal notice: the fleet knows that [defendant_nameFull] is with [playerFactionName]. A deserter who carried sealed files out of the fleet's databanks is a matter for the tribunal, and [asker_pronoun] would rather see it settled in court than on our doorstep.

The terms are plain. [defendant_nameDef] is to surrender to the fleet's local tribunal for investigation and questioning. Upon our agreement, [asker_pronoun] will requisition an orbital transport for [defendant_nameDef] without delay, and [issuerFactionName] will hold its guns for as long as the proceedings run.

Per [asker_nameDef], the inquiry closes within [investigationDays] days; the accused will then speak in [defendant_possessive] own defense before the bench, and the Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] will pass sentence for immediate execution. When the case is closed, the order to hunt [defendant_objective] down will be withdrawn.

The fleet will feed, house and treat [defendant_nameDef] throughout the sentence, and return [defendant_pronoun] to [playerFactionName] when it ends.[killOrderNote]

questDescription(defendantRanked==Deviant)->[asker_nameFull], sergeant of the military police command, [issuerFactionName], has broadcast an official communiqué addressed to [playerFactionName]. [asker_pronoun] frames it as nothing personal, merely procedure: [defendant_nameFull] deserted the fleet and leaked what was sealed, and a deserter answers to military jurisdiction wherever [defendant_pronoun] runs.

[asker_pronoun] requires that [defendant_nameDef] attend the fleet's local tribunal for investigation and questioning. The moment we consent, an orbital transport will be requisitioned to carry [defendant_nameDef] up, and [issuerFactionName] will suspend all hostilities against [playerFactionName] pending judgment.

As [asker_nameDef] lays it out: [investigationDays] days of investigation, then the accused argues [defendant_possessive] defense in open court, and the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall pronounces sentence on the spot. Whatever the verdict, closing the case closes the hunt.

Quarters, rations and medical care during the sentence come at [issuerFactionName]'s expense; [defendant_pronoun] will be shipped back to [playerFactionName] on release.[killOrderNote]

killOrderNote(killOrder==True)->\n\nThis trial concerns the deserter alone. The kill order over the occulted technology still stands: once the case is closed, [issuerFactionName] will treat us as enemies again, and lifting the kill order will take a separate court-martial.
killOrderNote(killOrder==False)->\n\nWith the case closed, relations with [issuerFactionName] will return to neutral.
arrivedLetterLabel->Tribunal transport arrived
arrivedLetterLabel->Orbital transport landed

arrivedLetterText->The orbital transport requisitioned by [askerName] has landed. [defendantName] must board it to attend the [issuerFactionName] military tribunal. Hostilities are suspended while the proceedings hold.
acquitLetterLabel->Acquitted: [defendantName]
acquitLetterLabel->Verdict: not guilty

acquitLetterText->Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has ruled the charges unfounded and ordered an immediate release, rank and record intact.\n\nThe officer corps was visibly impressed. [issuerFactionName] has extended formal recognition to us; our standing is now that of an ally. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.

acquitNoAllyLetterText->Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has ruled the charges unfounded and ordered an immediate release, rank and record intact.\n\nThe incident is closed, but the sealed technology still in our hands keeps [issuerFactionName] at arm's length: relations return to neutral, and no further. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.

acquitDeviantLetterText->Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has accepted the reasons behind the desertion and dismissed the charges, and the order to hunt [defendantName] down is withdrawn.\n\nThe fleet will go no further than that: relations return to neutral. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.
verdictLetterLabel->Verdict: [defendantName]
verdictLetterLabel->Sentence pronounced

verdictLetterText->The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has pronounced sentence. In consideration of [defendantName]'s cooperation, the punishment is set at the minimum: demotion from [oldTitle] to [newTitle], and [detentionDays] days of detention, effective immediately.\n\nThe fleet will cover room, board and medical care for the duration.

verdictLetterNoDemotionText->The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has pronounced sentence. [defendantName] holds no rank on the fleet's rolls, so there is nothing to strip: the punishment is [detentionDays] days of detention, effective immediately.
The fleet will cover room, board and medical care for the duration.

verdictLetterDeviantText->The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has pronounced sentence. [defendantName] once stood on the fleet's rolls and walked away from them; there is no rank left to strip, only the desertion and the leak to answer for: [detentionDays] days of detention, effective immediately.\n\nThe fleet will cover room, board and medical care for the duration. When the sentence is served, the hunt for [defendantName] ends.
returnAllyLetterLabel->[defendantName] returned: fleet's respect earned

returnAllyLetterText->[defendantName] has served the sentence and been returned by drop pod.\n\nThroughout detention, [defendantName]'s bearing and testimony left a strong impression on the [issuerFactionName] officer corps. The fleet has extended formal recognition to us: our standing with [issuerFactionName] is now that of an ally.
returnNeutralLetterLabel->[defendantName] returned

returnNeutralLetterText->[defendantName] has served the sentence and been returned by drop pod.\n\n[issuerFactionName] considers the incident formally closed. Relations remain neutral: the ceasefire holds, but no warmth came of it.
betrayLetterLabel->Tribunal terms violated

betrayLetterText->The court-martial arrangement with [issuerFactionName] has collapsed. The military police command has declared the proceedings void, and [issuerFactionName] has resumed hostilities against us.

acquitDeviantKillOrderLetterText->Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has accepted the reasons behind the desertion and dismissed the charges, and the order to hunt [defendantName] down is withdrawn.\n\nThe kill order over the occulted technology still stands, however. The truce ended with the case, and [issuerFactionName] is hostile to us again. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.
returnDeviantKillOrderLetterLabel->[defendantName] returned: kill order stands

returnDeviantKillOrderLetterText->[defendantName] has served the sentence and been returned by drop pod, and [issuerFactionName] has called off the hunt for [defendantName].\n\nThe kill order over the occulted technology still stands. The truce ended with the case, and [issuerFactionName] is hostile to us again. Lifting the kill order will take a separate court-martial.
